text: {"contradictions":[{"source":"དེ་ལྟར་ནང་གི་དངོས་པོ་ལ་ཟ་བ་པོར་འཛིན་པ་བཟློག་ནས་ཕྱི་རོལ་གྱི་དངོས་པོ་ལ་བཟའ་བར་འཛིན་པ་བཟློག་པའི་ཕྱིར་ཕྱི་སྟོང་པ་ཉིད་རྣམ་པར་གཞག་སྟེ།","english":"Having thus reversed the apprehension of internal things as a consumer , internal emptiness is established to reverse the apprehension of external things as the consumed .","kind":"sense","why":"The source says internal emptiness is established to reverse the apprehension of internal things, and external emptiness is established to reverse the apprehension of external things. The English incorrectly links the reversal of the consumer to the establishment of internal emptiness, and the reversal of the consumed to the establishment of external emptiness in a way that misrepresents the causal structure of the text.","certainty":"high"}],"omissions":[],"additions":[]}

contradictions.english: Having thus reversed the apprehension of internal things as a consumer , internal emptiness is established to reverse the apprehension of external things as the consumed .
contradictions.why: The source says internal emptiness is established to reverse the apprehension of internal things, and external emptiness is established to reverse the apprehension of external things. The English incorrectly links the reversal of the consumer to the establishment of internal emptiness, and the reversal of the consumed to the establishment of external emptiness in a way that misrepresents the causal structure of the text.
